description: Convert raw HTML markup into a print-ready base64 PDF via hermetic sandboxed headless Chrome (no external network requests). $0.003 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for terms, then call again with `payment`.

format.description: Optional paper format: A4 (default), Letter, Legal, Tabloid, A3, or A5.

html.description: HTML markup to render into PDF (up to 512 KB; inline CSS and data: URIs supported).

landscape.description: Optional: render landscape orientation when true (default false).

margin.description: Optional margin preset: none, compact, normal (default), or wide.

name: html_to_pdf
title: Html to pdf
